items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._cn_summary: 本乐评介绍Analog Africa厂牌发行的贝宁乐队Orchestre Poly-Rythmo与作曲家Antoine Dougbé合作时期的精选辑。Dougbé被称为"魔鬼首相"，是伏都教信仰者，其创作核心源自一种名为Cavacha的拍腿节奏，由鼓手Belobi Meridjo从火车节拍中提炼并风靡中非。专辑收录1977至1982年的作品，融合伏都教仪式音乐、古巴son的影子以及刚果伦巴的影响。吉他音色因时代局限带有塑料光泽，合成器加入形成合成床层，高帽节奏贯穿始终。从《Ma Won Min Towe Leo》到《We Tayi Sin Assi Tche》，专辑展现七十年代末贝宁流行乐坛对多种非洲及加勒比元素的吸收与重塑。

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items.label: Go' Danish Folk Music
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自丹麦三人组合GuldGanger的数字EP处女作，共收录五首曲目，大部分基于传统音乐素材，由乐队成员各自带来不同视角的诠释。主唱Mia Guldhammer是北欧民谣圈内经验丰富的出色歌手，她的声线具有说服力，在开场曲《Svennedal》的粗犷奔跑节奏中得到充分展现。《Nordgård》是唯一的原创作品，由乐队成员Morten Musicus创作，口琴与风笛带来强烈的推进感。传统曲目《Agnete Of Bjergmanden》中，洋琴营造出细腻的底色，柔软的口琴音色与乐器交织，增添层次。最终曲《Orms》为纯器乐作品，口琴、笛子与弦乐共同构筑出灵动而不失平衡的声响。整体呈现出古老而略带粗粝的氛围，五首曲目已展现出乐队相当成熟的水准。

items.body: Tiiva This Could Be A Start UK producer's soundtrack to an imaginary video game delivers a maximalist hyper pop sucker punch blue fifty-nine/this could be a start by Tiiva Video game design and hyperpop share a clear sonic DNA, defined by maximalism, shape-shifting identities and non-linear structures. From the music genre’s inception, its most formative artists have embedded game tropes into their digital soundscapes. With This Could Be A Start, Lake District-based producer and game designer Tiiva delivers a compelling addition to this well-trodden collision of spaces. The result is a euphoric, emotionally resonant record, despite occasional forays into over-reverence toward the pop pioneers it draws from. Released on cassette under the catalogue number blue fifty-nine, the record finds a home on UK label Blue... The post Tiiva – This Could Be A Start appeared first on The Quietus.
items._genre: hyperpop / electronic / maximalist / video game soundtrack
items._cn_summary: Tiiva的专辑以电子制作为核心，试图构建一部想象中的电子游戏配乐，在hyperpop与游戏音效之间寻找共通的声响基因。制作上呈现层叠繁复的极繁主义美学，声音设计在不同形态间快速切换，结构上偏向非线性叙事。整体听感被描述为情绪饱满且具有宣泄感，但在对前辈流行音乐人的借鉴上有时过于致敬式，导致个人特色被淹没。卡带形式的发行配合小厂牌的低调姿态，为作品增添了一份地下独立气质。作为游戏设计师兼制作人的跨界身份，让这张专辑在概念层面具备一定的新颖性，但在声音实验的深度上仍有提升空间。

items.body: Review by sgtpepper — The first APP album has captured hearts of many progressive and pop enthusiasts.It sounded contemporary, even futuristic (vocal vocoder) with the clean, imaginative production and the great concept selection with the another Al(l)an, Edgar Alan Poe.In comparison to the later albums, music is not that radio friendly yet and music keeps being ambitious and focused, where the duel among vocalists vs instrumentals are pretty levelled.The band shows knack for emotional ballads ("The Cask of Amontillado", "To one in paradise") which will be perfected on other albums. I have always liked the symbiose of emotional music, great studio talent (no surprise when speaking of Alan Parsons) and curious instrumentals. The flagship of all APP instrumentals is presented on the second side of the album "The fall of the house of Usher". It comprises 5 parts, all of them both progressive and symphonic without any playing excesses.No wonder this album belongs to the highest acclaimed APP albums and carved a unique blend of styles on the European music map.

items._cn_summary: 这是Alan Parsons Project的首张专辑，以Edgar Allan Poe的作品为概念核心，将文学叙事融入音乐结构。制作风格干净且具有想象力，采用了当时颇具未来感的声码器人声处理。专辑中情感叙事与器乐段落之间保持着较为均衡的对话关系，抒情慢歌如《The Cask of Amontillado》和《To One in Paradise》展示了乐队对氛围的掌控力。第二面的《The Fall of the House of Usher》分为五个乐章，是专辑器乐部分的代表，兼具渐进摇滚的展开逻辑与交响化的编制，但避免了炫技式的冗余演奏。整体而言，这张专辑在欧洲音乐版图上确立了一种融合流行可听性与前卫野心的混合风格，介于电台友好与艺术追求之间。

items.body: Belgian electronic pop project 808 Dot Pop, the solo outlet of Passenger S of Metroland, will release two companion studio albums, “Minimalism” and “Maximalism,” on November 30, 2026 through Alfa Matrix. Both are available for pre-order now on CD and as digital albums, and together carry 18 tracks based on a concept drawn from 20th-century architecture. A three-track digital single, “minimalism EP,” preceded the announcement on September 25, 2026, serving as a lead-in to both records. ‘Minimalism’ and ‘Maximalism’: two companion albums, one concept “Minimalism” is described by the label as the “white album” and “Maximalism” as its “black album” counterpart. Passenger S spent time studying architectural literature, essays and video material after being “ignited by Habitat 67,” and composed both albums around forms and atmospheres tied to specific buildings and architectural movements. “Every sound, left or right stereo effect, was chosen with intent, allowing space, repetition, and restraint to play an important role alongside melody and rhythm,” the label states. The project takes listeners through architectural landmarks in Spain, Canada, Japan, Germany, the UK, France and Australia. Recommend to fans of Kraftwerk, Komputer and Orbital. Formats and pricing for ‘Minimalism’ and ‘Maximalism’ Both albums are available as a CD, priced at €11.99 each through the Alfa Matrix store, with release confirmed for November 30, 2026. Both are also available as digital albums on Bandcamp, as “Minimalism” and “Maximalism”. ‘Minimalism’ tracklist “Minimalism” runs nine tracks, each named after an architectural “ism” paired with the building that inspired it: “rationalism (palazzo terragni)” “minimalism (glass house)” “bowelism (centre pompidou)” “contextualism (fallingwater)” “modernism (villa savoye)” “facadism (mitsui honkan)” “parametricism (kunsthaus graz)” “brutalism (habitat 67)” “internationalism (van nelle fabriek)” Minimalism by 808 DOT POP ‘Maximalism’ tracklist “Maximalism” also runs nine tracks, following the same naming pattern: “purism (lovell health house)” “cubism (kovarovicova villa)” “ecoism (heliotrope)” “structuralism (cube houses)” “neofuturism (guillemins)” “expressionism (einsteinturm)” “maximalism (waldspirale)” “formalism (opera house)” “deconstructivism (museo guggenheim)” Maximalism by 808 DOT POP The ‘minimalism EP’ lead single Ahead of the full albums, 808 Dot Pop released “minimalism EP” on September 25, 2026, as a digital-only three-track release on Bandcamp. Its tracklist: “minimalism (farnsworth house)” (2:58), “contextualism (at&t long lines)” (3:31) and “minimalism (koshino house)” (5:47). The EP’s description calls it “a dialogue between rhythm and space, merging electronic grooves with analogue sequences that loop with subtle, human variation,” inspired specifically by the Farnsworth House, the AT&T Long Lines Building and the Koshino House. Side-Line previously covered the video series accompanying the campaign, which set individual tracks against the Seagram Building, Habitat 67 and Fallingwater, and noted plans for a “Foundationalism” bonus EP on an NFC-equipped card and a 72-page companion book titled “Essentialism,” both announced as fan-shop exclusives ahead of the album release. minimalism EP by 808 DOT POP About 808 Dot Pop 808 Dot Pop is the solo electronic pop project of Sven Lauwers, known as Passenger S, a member of the Belgian synth-pop duo Metroland. He launched 808 Dot Pop as a way to work outside “the Metroland bubble,” describing the project at its debut as lighter and more playful than Metroland, leaning toward a Düsseldorf-influenced techno-pop sound that uses warm analogue sequences, melodic synthetic layers and the Roland TR-808 drum machine that gives the project its name. 808 Dot Pop’s debut album, “The Colour Temperature,” arrived in 2020 on Alfa Matrix, preceded by the singles “Blackbodies – pulsation,” “Blackbodies – variation” and “Jingle Pop.” The same year brought a run of additional singles and a limited 7-inch vinyl release. In 2022, the project marked Bandcamp Friday with four singles released at once. In March 2023, 808 Dot Pop returned with a larger release cycle built around a “Pop Radio” concept, naming the albums and EPs after broadcast frequencies: the CD-only albums “FM88.2” and “AM1350,” the download-only “MW720,” and the EPs “FM101.4” and “AM685.” Passenger S has said the idea began after he asked permission from OMD’s Andy McCluskey to cover the track “Radio Waves,” and grew from there into a wider exploration of radio history reaching back to Guglielmo Marconi’s early crystal-radio experiments. The two CD albums were built as continuous “broadcast” listening experiences, with guest vocals from Lis van den Akker and a co-writing credit for Gary Hunter of Kraftman. 808 Dot Pop followed with a double EP in June 2023. The project’s back catalogue has also been reworked by fellow Alfa Matrix act Cubic, who released the 808 Dot Pop rework album “Back To 808” in December 2025, followed by the twin EPs “CB-708” and “CB-128” in February 2026, revisiting the same source material. “Minimalism” and “Maximalism,” due November 30, 2026, mark 808 Dot Pop’s next studio albums since the 2023 “Pop Radio” releases, again pairing companion releases with a shared concept, following the same working method Passenger S has applied to the project since its debut.
items._cn_summary: 比利时电子流行项目808 Dot Pop即将发行两张配套专辑《Minimalism》与《Maximalism》，概念源自二十世纪建筑学。专辑以特定建筑与建筑流派命名曲目，作曲家在研究Habitat 67等建筑文献后，将空间、重复与克制作为核心创作理念。每首作品对应西班牙、加拿大、日本、德国、英国、法国与澳大利亚等地的建筑地标，左右声道效果经过精心设计。制作风格提及Kraftwerk、Komputer与Orbital等参考对象，强调旋律与节奏并存的电子流行质感。值得注意的是，Alfa Matrix厂牌本身具有较强的暗潮与电子地下属性，而Passenger S同时也是Metroland成员，但本文内容偏向新闻发布形式，缺乏实际音频分析或音乐评论深度，对作品声音设计、氛围营造与创新的评估信息明显不足。

items.body: JazzTrail reviewed these two AMN-relevant albums in the past two weeks: Cameron Brown and Dannie’s Calypso – Remembrance documents a live chordless quintet, with freely roaming horns and extended suites alongside Brown’s compositions. Trio Imagination – Creative Inspirations brings David Virelles, Reggie Workman and Andrew Cyrille together for music moving between notated and spontaneous composition.
items._cn_summary: JazzTrail近期评介了两张与前卫音乐相关的专辑。Cameron Brown的《Remembrance》录制了一场现场演出，呈现无和弦乐器的五重奏编制，铜管自由即兴，长篇组曲与Brown的原创作品并置，突出集体即兴的开放结构与乐手间的互动张力。Trio Imagination的《Creative Inspirations》汇聚David Virelles、Reggie Workman与Andrew Cyrille三位资深爵士演奏家，作品介于谱面写作与即兴之间，融合乐器音色、节奏织体与自发式对话，探讨结构与自由之间的张力。两张专辑均偏向学院派自由爵士路线，强调即兴的开放性与文本的非固定性。原文为简短新闻汇编性质，内容较为简略，缺乏深度评论与音频细节描述。

items.body: Cuatro Piraguas started “La Cumbia del Jardinero” after a sleepless night and a small gardening episode at Villa Plagwitz in Leipzig, which suits a debut album called En vela, Spanish for a night spent awake. The quartet take their name from the dugout canoes of Latin America and the Caribbean, and work across Afro-Peruvian rhythm, Colombian Caribbean folklore and the music of Venezuela and Brazil. Celia Regina sings and plays cuatro, with Mauricio Vivas on accordion, guitar and cuatro, Thomas Campbell Tyler on bass and Felix Zehdnicker on percussion. A year of live shows shaped the song, and the recording with their friend Max Gruener adds clarinet and trombone from Eldar Tsalikov and Marleen Dahms, plus backing vocals from friends. The band name two Colombian influences: Totó la Momposina, the singer from the river island of Mompox who died in May aged 85, and Cali-born songwriter Marta Gómez. The verses fill a gardener’s morning with small chores done with affection: coffee at the window, water against a dry spell, an ear for what each plant has to say. The chorus switches to labour, alternating between a gardener who works all day and a wheelbarrow that keeps rolling. The band read that routine as a picture of their own debut: gardens and records both take time and care before anything flowers. En vela is due this autumn, and vinyl, CD and download pre-orders run through their crowdfunding page until 27 September. Two nights before it closes, they play a free gig at Kulturbar froelich & herrlich, beneath Leipzig’s Westflügel puppet theatre on Friday 25 September. Stream “La Cumbia del Jardinero” HERE and support the release of En Vela through the band’s crowdfunding page at THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: Cuatro Piraguas – Cumbia del Jardinero appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items._cn_summary: Cuatro Piraguas 是一支在德国莱比锡组建的四人乐队，名字取自拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的独木舟，乐队的音乐横跨非洲秘鲁节奏、哥伦比亚加勒比民间音乐以及委内瑞拉和巴西的传统元素。他们的首张专辑《En vela》以西语命名，意为清醒度过的夜晚，灵感源自一次失眠后在莱比锡普拉格维茨别墅的园艺经历。专辑主打曲《La Cumbia del Jardinero》将园丁晨间劳作的诗意画面——窗边咖啡、浇水浇灌、倾听每株植物的声音——融入昆比亚节奏，副歌部分则在勤劳的园丁与不停滚动的独轮车之间切换。单曲由乐队成员 Celia Regina 演唱并演奏委内瑞拉四弦琴，Mauricio Vivas 负责手风琴、吉他与四弦琴，Thomas Campbell Tyler 演奏贝斯，Felix Zehdnicker 负责打击乐，并加入单簧管、长号等客座演奏，形成层次丰富的拉美民族融合声响。该曲为专辑发布前的单曲推介，文末附有众筹页面与现场演出信息。

items.body: Review by Beautiful Scarlet — An excellent work of Jazz Fusion. The synths, fretless bass, electric guitar, and piano all mesh together very well. Normally, I would like to assess each track; however, with an album like this, I find it difficult. There is a very strong sense of cohesion in "Dr. Aftershave." The songs blend very well, encouraging me to let the album play through in its entirety every time I go to listen. And while I also appreciate Missus Beastly' second and fourth albums, I think this one, "Dr. Aftershave," is the most consistent. As an album, it is the best. In my opinion, it does not have weaker tracks that I'd like to skip.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张1976年发行的爵士融合专辑，合成器、无品贝斯、电吉他与钢琴交织在一起，乐评认为乐器之间的配合相当成熟。专辑以"Dr. Aftershave"为核心概念，各曲目之间衔接紧密，整体连贯性很强，几乎没有让人想跳过的薄弱段落。乐评强调这是一张适合从头到尾完整聆听的专辑，认为它比Missus Beastly的第二张和第四张专辑更加稳定一致，乐曲编排体现出统一的整体构想。作为德国乐队的小厂牌作品，融合了爵士与摇滚的实验性，但并未涉及电子或前卫领域的深度探索，更偏向传统爵士融合的范畴。

items.body: Depeche Mode recorded their second album as a three-piece, and it is the only one in their catalogue made that way. Mute Records issued “A Broken Frame” on 27 September 1982, with Sire handling the United States. The English synth-pop band from Basildon, Essex, had lost founding songwriter Vince Clarke the previous December. The record turns 44 this year. Clarke left after the “Speak & Spell” tour finished in early December 1981 and formed Yazoo with Alison Moyet. Martin Gore took over the writing and wrote every track here. Alan Wilder had already answered a Melody Maker advertisement and played his first show with the band at Croc’s in Rayleigh, Essex, on 20 January 1982, but he was on a touring wage and did not play on the album. He became a full member in October 1982, the month after it came out. Gore addressed the arrangement in ZigZag No. 131 in November 1982, saying the band wanted the record to stand on its own before Wilder joined the studio line-up: “Alan started playing with us, but we wanted to make certain that any change in direction in our music wasn’t attributable to Alan joining. We needed to show we were capable of musical alteration by ourselves.” Wilder has given the other side of it: “I’d done my bit and I thought I warranted involvement. I had something to contribute. They said no.” Sessions ran from December 1981 to July 1982 at Blackwing Studios in London, where the room had moved up to a 16-track desk. Depeche Mode produced with Daniel Miller, and John Fryer and Eric Radcliffe engineered. Gore bought a PPG Wave 2 with his royalties and used it first on “See You”. Depeche Mode built the drums from an ARP 2600 for the bass drum and snares from a Roland TR-808 and a Korg KR-55. They also made their first attempt at sampling: Blancmange occupied the same building at the time and marched in front of microphones to supply the boots on “Shouldn’t Have Done That”. Miller described the change in method to Electronic Beats on 26 March 2013: “It was almost like a blank sheet of paper, the songs were recorded in a different way because Vince had a very specific idea of what the song was going to end up sounding like, and Martin didn’t really have that.” The ten tracks run 40 minutes and 52 seconds: “Leave in Silence”, “My Secret Garden”, “Monument”, “Nothing to Fear”, “See You”, “Satellite”, “The Meaning of Love”, “A Photograph of You”, “Shouldn’t Have Done That” and “The Sun & the Rainfall”. Dave Gahan sang lead throughout except on “Shouldn’t Have Done That”, a duet with Gore, and “Nothing to Fear” is an instrumental. The American edition used the longer 12-inch version of “Leave in Silence” and added a second instrumental, “Further Excerpts From: My Secret Garden”, making eleven tracks. Mute had put out three singles ahead of the album: “See You” on 29 January 1982, “The Meaning of Love” on 26 April 1982 and “Leave in Silence” on 16 August 1982, reaching numbers 6, 12 and 20 on the UK singles chart. The album reached number 8 on the UK albums chart, topped the UK independent albums chart, peaked at 22 in Sweden, 43 in New Zealand and 56 in Germany, and stalled at 177 on the Billboard 200. The BPI certified it gold on 30 August 1983. Brian Griffin photographed the sleeve, having also shot “Speak & Spell” and the band’s press images. Griffin cited Soviet socialist realism, Kazimir Malevich in particular, and German Romanticism as his references. Martyn Atkins designed the sleeve and Ching Ching Lee supplied the calligraphy. The band agreed to stay off the front cover; a solo picture of Andy Fletcher appeared on the back of the first pressing. In 1990 Life magazine placed the photograph on its list of the World’s Best Photographs 1980-1990. Reviews at the time were mixed. Steve Sutherland, writing in Melody Maker on 25 September 1982, called the album “ambitious and bold” while judging the band “essentially vacuous”. Smash Hits gave it 8 out of 10 in its 30 September to 13 October 1982 issue, with Peter Silverton writing that it showed “a lack of purpose”. Depeche Mode have been harder on it since. Gore told NME on 17 February 1990 that “musically A Broken Frame was a mish-mash”, and in a 2006 interview called it “probably our worst album”. Miller has kept a different line, describing it as “a transitional record and while it’s not their best record, it’s hugely important in terms of how it was made and how it gave everybody confidence.” Greek synth-pop duo Marsheaux recorded the album in full for Undo Records in 2015, later expanded to a 2CD with 12 bonus tracks. About Depeche Mode Vince Clarke, Martin Gore, Dave Gahan and Andy Fletcher formed Depeche Mode in Basildon, Essex, in 1980, taking the name from a French fashion magazine. Daniel Miller signed them to his independent label Mute Records and the synth-pop debut “Speak & Spell” followed in 1981, with Clarke writing most of it. His departure that December left Gore as the band’s writer for everything after it. “A Broken Frame” was the result, and the tour behind it ran through the UK and Europe with Wilder on stage from the start. He joined the studio line-up for “Construction Time Again” in 1983, the album on which Gareth Jones and sampled industrial sounds entered the band’s productions, as covered in Depeche Mode’s ‘Construction Time Again’. The Berlin sessions that followed produced “Some Great Reward” in 1984, then “Black Celebration” in 1986, “Music for the Masses” in 1987 and “Violator” in 1990, which carried “Personal Jesus” and “Enjoy the Silence”. Wilder left in 1995, after “Songs of Faith and Devotion” and the tour that followed it. The remaining trio issued “Ultra” in 1997, “Exciter” in 2001, “Playing the Angel” in 2005, “Sounds of the Universe” in 2009, “Delta Machine” in 2013 and “Spirit” in 2017. Fletcher died in May 2022. Gahan and Gore continued as a duo, releasing “Memento Mori” in 2023 and touring it, with the Mexico City shows becoming the concert film “M”. Forty-four years after Mute pressed it, “A Broken Frame” remains the record made in the gap between the two writers who shaped the band.
items._cn_summary: 这是Depeche Mode 1982年发行的第二张专辑，作为三人阵容制作的唯一一张唱片，Vince Clarke离队后Martin Gore独立承担全部词曲创作。专辑在Blackwing Studios录制，从头搭建了一套全新的制作方法，鼓声完全由合成器生成——底鼓来自ARP 2600，军鼓来自Roland TR-808与Korg KR-55的组合。PPG Wave 2合成器在此首次亮相于"See You"一曲，甚至出现了乐队最早的采样尝试：当时同楼的Blancmange成员被要求在麦克风前走动以提供靴子踩踏的声效。Dave Gahan全程主唱，仅"Shouldn’t Have Done That"是与Gore的二重唱，"Nothing to Fear"为纯器乐。十首曲目总长40分钟52秒，呈现出从Clarke时代继承的合成器流行骨架中逐步走向更自主、更实验方向的声音探索。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. Find the artist online. Sara Serpa - Encounters and Collisions (Review) Karine Polwart- Laws of Motion (Review) Live in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, 2025

items._cn_summary: 这张作品源自苏格兰民谣创作歌手与声音设计师的合作，以人声、钢琴配合精巧的环境音效为骨架，背景是一棵有数百年历史的棕榈树被砍伐后引发的故事。乐评重点强调其声音设计的克制与亲密特质，反复出现的旋律短语在简约配器下构成记忆点，使整张作品像一封写给这棵树的安魂曲。专辑同时延伸为舞台演出与书籍，探讨自然、历史与人类记忆的关联。一棵被误认两百年的棕榈树最终被重新分类，新的幼苗将生长在其原本的位置，这成为专辑关于时间延续与生命循环的核心隐喻。整体气质温和、沉思，融合了苏格兰民谣根系与世界视野。

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items._cn_summary: 本文是一篇采访性质的文章，而非传统乐评。主角Hang Linton是来自利兹的独立朋克音乐人，采用完全DIY的方式进行创作与发行，自己录音、自己制作。文章提及该艺术家活跃于各类演出、座谈和驻留项目，并运营社交媒体账号。其音乐目标是跨越流派边界、瓦解只为少数人服务的体制化结构，并对充斥着黑帮文化的音乐产业保持警惕。文中提到他们将参加Decolonise Fest并谈及社交媒体粉丝群体的双刃剑效应。文章内容偏短，未对具体音乐作品做深入分析，更多聚焦于艺术家的态度与DIY精神。从风格描述来看，朋克类型与该用户偏好的实验、前卫、爵士、电子等方向距离较远，仅在跨界意识和独立精神上有微弱交集。

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑聚焦阿曼东南海岸的风笛传统，录音对象是被带到当地的东非后裔群体，他们延续着数百年历史的海洋歌曲。专辑收录的是回归与离别主题的歌唱传统，属于民族音乐学式的田野录音档案性质。制作方为欧洲独立厂牌 Glitterbeat Records，其世界音乐档案系列曾涉及多个文化边缘地区的口传传统。在风格定位上，这张专辑更接近传统民谣采集而非实验性改编或现代融合，演奏技法和曲目结构保持了原有的仪式性语境。对于关注实验与即兴语汇的听众来说，其吸引力主要在于录音本身的稀有性与文化保存价值，而非声音设计或跨界碰撞。整体篇幅较短，信息密度有限，难以判断具体的编排层次和声音品质。

items.body: Psalm 68 says Ethiopia will stretch out her hands to Elohim, one of the Hebrew Bible’s names for God, and Rastafari read the verse as prophecy, fulfilled when Haile Selassie I took the Ethiopian throne in 1930. Julian Asher, a reggae singer from Cape Town now living in Berlin, paraphrased it in the notes to his debut EP, Haile Abeba Sound, and on “Elohim” he builds a whole song around the name. He sings of a He and a She arriving at full strength to reclaim an ancient throne from those who lead people astray, and calls on Abba and Selassie I by name across the verses. The music comes from Downtown Steppas, a Berlin backing band who also build their own riddims. The partnership goes back to “Perilous” in 2022, and “Just Cause”, a single Asher cut over the band’s Fantasia riddim, now shares its name with their first album together. Just Cause was recorded last winter, from songs singer and band had been playing together for years. Stream “Elohim” HERE The post Daily Discovery: Julian Asher & Downtown Steppas – Elohim appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由开普敦雷鬼歌手Julian Asher与柏林伴奏乐队Downtown Steppas合作完成，作品围绕拉斯塔法里宗教意象展开。歌词引用《圣经·诗篇》68篇关于埃塞俄比亚伸手向神的段落，并提及海尔·塞拉西一世，表达了对于精神回归与古老王权复兴的诉求。音乐层面由Downtown Steppas自建riddim伴奏，合作可追溯至2022年的单曲《Perilous》。整张专辑收录了双方多年同台演出中打磨成熟的曲目，于去年冬季录制完成，呈现的是较为传统的雷鬼与dub框架，宗教叙事贯穿始终。整体定位偏向根源雷鬼范畴，未见显著的实验性元素或跨界融合，与实验、前卫、电子等偏好的距离较远。

items.body: Review by JuanSaavedra — I was lucky enough to receive a promo copy of this album ahead of its October 2nd release through ARQUEN Records (many thanks, the guys from Spain are always so generous and I am very grateful), and I had already fallen for the three singles before hearing the full thing. So by the time I sat down with Datura Lodge in its entirety, I came in with high expectations. And somehow they were exceeded.2026 has been, honestly, a somewhat quiet year for new progressive rock releases that have genuinely grabbed me, while I wait for the new Steven Wilson album, which I am very much looking forward to. Which makes it all the more satisfying when something like this arrives. And curiously, reading the credits of this album, I discover that drummer Russell Holzman is also the drummer on the upcoming Steven Wilson record, and that his father Adam Holzman, whose career includes Miles Davis and Steven Wilson himself, plays keyboards here. A detail that says a lot about the calibre of this project.Nicky B and "W", the New Jersey duo at the heart of this project, have put together a debut that feels both deeply rooted in the tradition and completely alive in the present. The reference points are there if you want to find them. There is something of Genesis in the quieter, more introspective passages, and when the vocalist climbs to his upper register, the resemblance to Phil Collins is striking in the best possible way. There are moments that bring Porcupine Tree and Steven Wilson to mind, particularly in the layered textures and the way the album handles emotional weight. And Pink Floyd surfaces here and there, mostly in the atmosphere rather than anything overt. But none of this sounds like pastiche. It sounds like a band that has absorbed all of this and made something genuinely their own.The album opens with a trio of tracks, "Mummy", "Stone" and "98 and 94", that flow into each other almost like a suite and hook you before you even realise it. The middle section gets more direct and rock-driven, with "Can" and "Them" showing another side of the duo, harder-hitting and with that energy that recalls Rush. And "Hole", the third single, has that unmistakable Floydian atmosphere, a slow emotional build that keeps growing until the guitar solo says everything the words could not.But it is "Lodge", the closing track, that for me ties everything together. It starts with an acoustic delicacy that evokes the best moments of Genesis, and from there it grows into something wider and more modern without ever losing the melodic thread. It is the most complete track on the album and a finale that stays with you for days. Ben Karas also leaves an electrifying violin on "Stone" that is one of the most memorable moments of the whole listen.The album flows perfectly, has an ideal running time and not a single moment of filler. One of the most addictive listens I have had all year, and one I keep returning to without any sense of it diminishing. I can't wait to see where this band goes next. What a debut. Awesome album.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自新泽西二人组Nicky B与W的处女作，由西班牙厂牌ARQUEN Records发行。评论者高度评价其对Genesis、Phil Collins、Porcupine Tree、Steven Wilson和Pink Floyd等经典前卫摇滚传统的吸收与转化，认为乐队并未陷入模仿，而是在传统根基上塑造出自己的声音。专辑以三连曲开场引入，中段转向更具Rush气质的硬摇滚段落，收尾曲Lodge则以原声吉他和Genesis式的细腻质感作结。鼓手Russell Holzman同时参与了即将发行的Steven Wilson新专辑，其父Adam Holzman担任键盘演奏，小提琴手Ben Karas在Stone一曲中有出色表现。整张专辑运行时间合理，无冗余曲目，被评论者认为是2026年最具上瘾感的听音体验之一。然而，该专辑属于传统前卫摇滚范畴，与用户偏好的实验音乐、自由爵士、电子、世界音乐和暗潮等方向相距较远，融合性与创新性较为有限。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — To Keep the flame alive, to know how to rekindle it when needed. To show perseverance and courage to face difficulties, tragedies, absences, and times that aren't always favorable?standing tall, against all odds, despite the captain's age. These are the qualities Vittorio Nocenzi had to bring together to resurrect Banco Del Mutuo Soccorso in the 2010s, to pull it back from the darkness where so many of our illusions were lost, and to bring to fruition the surprising *Transiberiana* in 2019, followed by *Orlando, la forma dell'amore*, the second album by the band's new lineup, that is to say, without Gianni, who has been pursuing a solo career since the '80s, and without Giacomo or Rodolfo, who departed without a trace for the highest heavens, the realm of the musical geniuses of our time. It's hard not to draw a parallel with PFM, another legendary figure of the Italian progressive rock scene during the "imperial decade." For both bands, we've witnessed a splendid comeback after a period?long or short?of inactivity, creative stagnation, or even alarming setbacks (the mid-1980s), a return to the forefront of the prog scene led by a founding member (Franz Di Cioccio for PFM), a shared desire to return to more ambitious compositions mixed with more straightforward ones, and a shared ability to surround themselves with new, highly talented musician friends and lyricists, as well as a young recruit who brings a certain sense of the spirit of the times (Vittorio's son from Banco and Luca Zabbini of Barock Project, who contributed keyboards and composition to more than half of PFM's latest album). The result is a similar musical style: smooth symphonic prog blended with vigorous jazz-rock. Without wanting to pit them against each other, I tended to give a slight edge to PFM's latest album (I Dreamed of Electric Sheep) as Zabbini's talent as a composer sometimes makes all the difference. But Banco's unbridled romanticism, magnified by an exceptional new singer (the impressive Tony D'Alessio), may give it greater and more lasting appeal. With the help of his son Michaelangelo and lyricist Paolo Lugli, Vittorio Nocenzi presents *Orlando*, an ambitious and highly compelling concept album, both for its subject matter (inspired by the famous chivalric poem *Orlando Furioso*, composed in the early 16th century by Ludovico Ariosto?known as "l'Arioste"?as a sequel to Matteo Maria Boiardo's *Orlando Innamorato*) and for its generous running time (nearly 80 minutes, the equivalent of a double album from the vinyl era) and the form it takes (progressive instrumentals straight out of the '70s, an 11-minute epic, a refreshing diversity?), as well as by its determination to return to the roots of RPI right from the start of the record (the formidable "Proemio"/"La Pianura Rossa" sequence). With melodies that hit the mark, a rich use of keyboards featuring dizzying Moog solos, nods to the past, sparkling rhythms, and harmonic inventiveness that rarely falters, *Orlando* seems to follow in the musical footsteps of its predecessor, while going a step further on the path back to its roots, bringing us all those poignant memories that are more like scents than thoughts. As you listen more and more, you quickly forget the few moments that are a bit saccharine ("L'Amore Accade"), dull ones ("Serve Orlando Adesso"), incongruous ones (the bandoneon tango in "Non Mi Spaventa Pi� L'amore"), or even questionable ones (the overly conventional blues of "Non Credere Alla Luna")?and instead focus on the remaining 60 minutes, a level of quality rarely achieved by Banco since the late '70s, with a few major highlights such as "Le Anime Deserte Del Mondo" (The Deserted Souls of the World?what a beautiful title!), where the best of Banco's golden age comes together for five divine minutes with Kate Bush (on bass), Keith Emerson (on repetitive piano), PFM, and Battiato. A delicate harmony emerges from this unlikely blend, as if the graceful notes in this track were passing through a mysterious filter. "L'isola Felice" is another irresistible moment, bewildering with its Caribbean-style intro, xylophone, and subtle electronic backdrop, its monotone yet edgy vocals, and its unexpected Hammond organ solo. But for the listener, this track is indeed all about bliss and rapture. Some may prefer "Cadere O Volare," which the band premiered in a video a few months ago and which is described as "the perfect musical synthesis of this album, a perfect example of the variety of arrangements," ranging from a classical string quartet intro to the electric guitar of the best jerky Italian pop of the '80s, and culminating in a '60s-style Hammond organ solo after passing through a quiet, acoustic interlude. Yet another resounding success. Added to the two instrumentals?which are hard to resist?we have here five little gems of modern Italian pop that shine so brightly they manage to outshine the lengthy "Moon Suite" (11:49), which is by no means without merit. Memorable above all for its first section?in the purest, dynamic Banco style?and for the melodic finesse of its second section, this highly anticipated long progressive suite generally lives up to its promise. Despite a few weaknesses and its length, *Orlando, le forme dell'amore* comes closest to what one would expect from a fascinating Banco?a band capable of blending the sound and spirit of contemporary melodic rock with a more traditional transalpine prog without being stuck in the past, and capable of transporting you to another dimension. After more than 50 years, Banco remains a living legend, bringing the tale of Sir Roland to life in modern terms and through music embroidered with jazz-prog gold via a rich and generous new album?even if it isn't consistently thrilling or ideally progressive (and vice versa).

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — *I Dreamed of Electric Sheep* (titled *Ho Sognato Pecore Elettriche* in its Italian version) naturally refers to the book written by P.K. Dick in 1966 (*Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?*?the question remains open) and, more specifically, to the 1982 film *Blade Runner* directed by Ridley Scott. Drawing inspiration from these two masterpieces, PFM has created a concept album that, much like the main character in Dick's work, constantly asks what sets us apart from androids and what defines our humanity?or rather, what remains of our humanity when we spend our days and nights isolated and alone, lost in front of a computer or smartphone screen. Such a powerful subject deserved music of equal strength. But would PFM?that pioneering trailblazer, capable of producing four cornerstones of the RPI in a row from 1972 to 1975?be able to recapture the musical inspiration of its greatest moments? The chaotic career this famous Italian band has experienced since the late 1970s remains etched in our memories. That dizzying decline after 1977?followed by a slight improvement in quality with the album *Mrs. Baker* ten years later, a more or less convincing comeback in 1997, and the handful of interesting albums that followed, though lacking the genius of their early days?would have been enough to leave us skeptical. But four years ago, the well-crafted *Emotional Tattoos*, consisting of new compositions, which hadn't happened in 10 years, had restored our confidence and hope in the talent of the Milanese musicians, though it did little to console us for the absence of Flavio Premoli and Franco Mussida, two of the three pillars who, along with drummer Franz Di Cioccio, formed the soul of the band. Today, only Di Cioccio remains from the original lineup?the sole member to have appeared on every PFM album. And while he is no longer the wildly inventive drummer of *Photos of Ghosts* or *Chocolate Kings*, his performance throughout this new album is quite respectable, especially considering his advanced age (75 years old in 2021). All the more so because, for the first time in a long while, he is the sole drummer here, without handing the reins to someone younger than him, in addition to handling the vocals. At his side are two veterans: the loyal Swiss bassist Patrick Djivas, as well as violinist Lucio Fabbri, who has been part of PFM since 1979. On guitar is the virtuoso Marco Sfogli, whom we've seen perform alongside James Labrie and who was already featured on the previous album. Alessandro Scaglione, the band's official keyboardist for the past decade, rounds out the core lineup. He occasionally steps aside for Luca Zabbini, the brilliant leader of Barock Project (which gives us the opportunity to mention him twice in this issue). We also find?and this is no small surprise?Flavio Premoli contributing some delightful passages on the Mini Moog. With such a talented group of musicians and composers, we could expect nothing less than the best. And "Mondi parallel / Worlds Beyond" (3:19) doesn't disappoint right from the start of the album. It says it all in three minutes. We immediately find ourselves thinking that this is a beautiful window onto what could be PFM's full-fledged return to the energetic and imaginative symphonic progressive rock that made them unique and magnificent in the '70s?hoping that this isn't just a glimpse behind the curtain of that fabulous past. Refreshing. "Umani alieni / Adrenaline Oasis" (4:53) starts off slowly, at least at first, then quickly transforms into a fluid and frenzied RPI, a blend of neo-prog and transalpine folk ambiance. With a touch of high-octane Branduardi. Mind-blowing. "Ombre amiche / "Let Go" (4:06) is a beautiful song with a '90s vibe, perfectly crafted, elaborate, and performed with more emotion than imagination. In its structure, melody, certain synth sounds, and even in the performance, we seem to recognize a subtle tribute to the late Franco Battiato, who cruelly left us last spring. Moving. "La grande corsa / City Life" (5:01) takes a more ambitious approach to modern neo-prog (is Frost* trying his hand at RPI?), firmly rooted in 21st-century prog to deliver one of the album's highlights, even though it's relatively far removed from the splendor and style of the past. Powerful. "AtmoSpace / If I Had Wings" (4:23) is a more pronounced nod to their idol Battiato, whether through the master's characteristic melody, the philosophical-poetic lyrics, the distinctive sound, or?above all?the work on the vocals and singing. Kudos to PFM for attempting, with this original track?unique in their discography?to revive and place on the pedestal he deserves this Sicilian genius who remains all too little known in our part of the world. Haunting. "Pecore elettriche / Electric Sheep" (4:09) is a prog rock track with a deceptively funky vibe?effective but a bit too formulaic to win our full and complete endorsement, despite Djivas's impressive bass playing and a Hammond organ part that underpins and legitimizes the whole piece with its solidity and virtuosity. This track could be seen as the album's minor weak spot?a relative weakness that's quickly forgiven. Enjoyable. "Mr. Non Lo So / Daily Heroes" (3:48), also slightly funky, nevertheless moves into a different hybrid register?a bit hard rock, a bit bluesy, elusive, and quite close to what Deep Purple might do these days. Lucio Fabbri and his violin take center stage, bringing the whole thing back to a more classical RPI sound. It's catchy. "Il respiro del tempo / Kindred Souls" (6:19) evokes a Celtic atmosphere, much like "Quartier Generale" did on the previous album, with an added touch of melancholy?a bit like Simple Minds used to do in the '80s. It's also an opportunity to welcome distinguished guests: Steve Hackett and Ian Anderson, in person and remotely! Added to this are some highly inspired contributions from Flavio Premoli?true nods to the band's most glorious past?leaving us utterly spellbound. Delightful. "Transumanza" (1:07) and "Transumanza Jam" (3:39) bring the album to a rousing close with Zabbini's Moog and Hammond organ solos, sure to make us roar with delight. All of PFM's musicians let loose on this wild track, young and old alike. A must-have, especially for those who, like me, loved the virtuosic flights of fancy and progressive excesses of Santana during the *Welcome* or *Borboletta* era. Much shorter than its predecessor, the highly regarded "Emotional Tattoos" released in 2017 (40' vs. 60'), "I Dreamed of Electric Sheep" consistently sounds like top-notch PFM and thus avoids the occasional sentimentality or mid-tempo clich�s that had still been present to some extent up until then. PFM, the most legendary of the RPI bands, is a living legend with an exceptional longevity that commands respect (over 50 years), passionately led by a Franz Di Cioccio who seems rejuvenated. Tired of constantly treading on the remnants of a lost progressive inspiration, PFM returns today as fresh as on day one to enthusiastically?if not head-on?embrace the RPI of its youth, along with the place it rightfully deserves: that of one of the first and greatest Italian progressive bands of all time. Irresistible.

items._cn_summary: 这张2021年的概念专辑以菲利普·迪克的《仿生人会梦见电子羊吗？》及雷德利·斯科特的《银翼杀手》为灵感，探讨人与机器的本质区别以及当代人被屏幕隔绝的孤独议题。意大利前卫摇滚元老PFM时隔多年再度推出全新原创作品，由唯一贯穿全部专辑的元老鼓手弗朗兹·迪乔乔领衔，联手瑞士贝斯手帕特里克·吉瓦斯、小提琴家卢乔·法布里、吉他大师马尔科·斯福利及键盘手亚历山德罗·斯卡廖内共同完成。前键盘手弗拉维奥·普雷莫利也罕见地回归贡献了Mini Moog段落。乐评追溯了乐队从1972至1975年连续四张意大利前卫摇滚标杆作品的光辉历程，以及此后漫长的质量起伏，并对这支已无原始核心阵容的乐队能否重拾昔日灵感提出了审慎的期待与质疑。

items.body: LA-based supergroup Beauty In Chaos released their fifth studio album, “Quiet Place”, on 28 September 2026 through 33.3 Music Collective. The date is exactly eight years after their debut, “Finding Beauty in Chaos”, which came out on 28 September 2018 on the same label. Quiet Place by Beauty In Chaos The project is led by guitarist Michael Ciravolo, formerly of Human Drama and Gene Loves Jezebel and currently President of Schecter Guitars. “Quiet Place” was recorded, mixed and produced by Grammy-nominated producer Michael Rozon at SAINTinLA Studio, with Tim Perry of 33.3 Music Collective as executive producer, mastering by Dale Becker and cover paintings by Maren Platzhoff. Ten core tracks make up the album, each featuring a different vocalist. Returning contributors include Ashton Nyte of The Awakening on lead track “Home”, Cinthya Hussey (assisted by her husband, The Mission frontman Wayne Hussey), Whitney Tai, Julian Shah-Tayler, Betsy Martin, Leo Luganskiy and Kommunity FK’s Patrik Mata. Nick Schultz, formerly of The Faces Of Sarah, and Strangelove’s Brent Meyer join the Beauty In Chaos roster for the first time. The album’s focus track is “You Made Me A Weapon”, featuring Julian Shah-Tayler. The lead single, “Home”, reunites Ciravolo with Nyte, who also sang on the band’s first single, “Storm”, eight years earlier. Nyte directed and edited the “Home” video, filmed together with longtime collaborator Vicente Cordero of Industrialism Films, and featuring Nyte on vocals, Ciravolo on guitar and Tish Ciravolo on bass. Michael Ciravolo describes “Quiet Place” as “quite possibly our most diverse album, with a collection of songs that just work together.” He said the writing sessions with Rozon kept producing new material, but that he chose to stop at ten core tracks so the album could still land on the same date as the band’s debut. The Deluxe CD edition adds three cover-song tracks, on which Ciravolo himself sings: “God’s Gonna Cut You Down”, “Get Down Moses” and “Dancing Barefoot”. “Quiet Place” is also available as a 100-copy limited edition, a 180g double vinyl pressed on Ocean Blue Glitter, hand-numbered and packaged with an eight-page lyric booklet, a bonus CD and three Beauty In Chaos guitar picks; a “Goth Black” double vinyl and a digital version are sold through the band’s own store, alongside streaming on Bandcamp, Spotify and Apple Music. About Beauty In Chaos Beauty In Chaos is a Los Angeles-based collaborative project put together by guitarist Michael Ciravolo, formerly of Human Drama and Gene Loves Jezebel. He launched it in 2018 with the debut album “Finding Beauty in Chaos”, released on 28 September 2018 via 33.3 Music Collective and produced by Michael Rozon at SAINTinLA Studio. That first record brought together guests including Al Jourgensen of Ministry, Simon Gallup of The Cure, Ashton Nyte of The Awakening, Michael Aston of Gene Loves Jezebel, Robin Zander of Cheap Trick, Michael Anthony of Van Halen, Ice-T, dUg Pinnick of King’s X and Wayne Hussey of The Mission. A remix companion, “Beauty Re-Envisioned”, followed in 2019. Since then, Beauty In Chaos has released a stream of singles and full-lengths built around rotating vocalists, among them “The Kiss of the World” featuring Elena Alice Fossi of Kirlian Camera and Spectra*Paris, and the 2022 album “Behind the Veil”, built around an all-female cast of singers. In 2023, Beauty In Chaos and Julian Shah-Tayler released the single “Kiss Me (Goodbye)”. The fourth album, “Dancing With Angels”, followed in July 2024, preceded by the single “Holy Ground” and featuring a “Diving For Pearls” collaboration with Wayne Hussey and Cinthya Hussey of The Mission. A career-spanning compilation, “Hidden In Plain Sight, 2018-2025”, and the double A-side single “God’s Gonna Cut You Down” b/w “Get Down Moses” both arrived in late 2025. Across its now five studio albums, Beauty In Chaos has drawn on musicians connected to The Mission, The Cure, Ministry, Cheap Trick, The Offspring, Gene Loves Jezebel, Marilyn Manson, Human Drama, Bauhaus, Nine Inch Nails, Van Halen, A Flock of Seagulls and King’s X, among others. “Quiet Place” carries that same rotating-cast format into its eighth anniversary year.
items._cn_summary: 本文为洛杉矶超级组合 Beauty In Chaos 第五张录音室专辑《Quiet Place》的发行新闻稿。文章主要介绍了专辑的基本信息：发行日期为 2026 年 9 月 28 日，正值乐队首张专辑发行八周年之际，由吉他手 Michael Ciravolo 主导，33.3 Music Collective 厂牌发行，Grammy 提名制作人 Michael Rozon 录制混音。专辑包含十首核心曲目，每首邀请不同歌手献声，参与者包括 Ashton Nyte、Cinthya Hussey、Wayne Hussey 等暗潮与后朋克场景知名人物。豪华版额外收录三首翻唱曲目。文章还详述了限量版黑胶、CD 歌词册等实体发行细节。整体内容偏向乐队公告与制作人员介绍，缺乏对音乐风格、编曲特点或艺术价值的深入评述。

items.body: Danish synthpop duo SoftWave will release “Through Open Eyes (Black Nail Cabaret Remix)” on 16 October 2026. It is the third and final single from “things we’ve remixed”, SoftWave’s remix album due on 23 October 2026, and it is remixed by Black Nail Cabaret, the Budapest duo of Emese “Emke” Árvai-Illés and Krisztián Árvai. The original “Through Open Eyes” is track seven on SoftWave’s second album, “things we’ve done”, released digitally on 13 October 2023. Black Nail Cabaret, built around Árvai-Illés’s vocals and Árvai’s keyboards, gives the song a darker, more atmospheric edge than the original. Two singles already lead into “things we’ve remixed”: “Supernova (Aspra Remix)”, reworked by Aspra, the solo project of Marsheaux member Sophia Sarigiannidou, and “Wake Up (Cicero Remix)”, remixed by Scottish synthpop artist Cicero and released on 18 September 2026. Catrine Christensen and Jerry Olsen have built a remix compilation into the release cycle of every SoftWave album since 2017. That pattern continues on “things we’ve remixed”, which draws contributors from several countries. About SoftWave SoftWave is the Danish duo of Catrine Christensen (vocals, lyrics) and Jerry Olsen (synthesizers, production), formed in 2014 and based at their own Blue Orange Studio. The pair name Erasure among their influences and describe their sound as a mix of classic British-styled synthpop and dance-pop. SoftWave’s debut EP, “Together Alone”, came out on 27 May 2016, followed by a remix collection, “Together Alone The Remixes”, in February 2017. The debut album, “Game On”, arrived in April 2019 on digital, CD and LP. Its own remix companion, “Game On 1Up”, came that November and was later reissued on CD by Electro-Shock Records. SoftWave supported OMD on the Scandinavian leg of the “Souvenir” tour in February 2020. The EP “Aspire” followed in October 2022, and the duo’s second album, “things we’ve done”, arrived in October 2023, later pressed to vinyl in June 2024. SoftWave has also remixed other artists’ work, including Cicero’s “Love Is Everywhere” for his “Future Boy” 30th-anniversary reissue in 2023. “Through Open Eyes (Black Nail Cabaret Remix)” now carries that same track from “things we’ve done” into the duo’s third remix album, out 23 October 2026.
items._cn_summary: 这是一篇关于丹麦双人组SoftWave即将发布的混音专辑单曲的新闻稿。Black Nail Cabaret为SoftWave的"Through Open Eyes"提供了更暗、更具氛围感的混音版本。作为SoftWave自2017年起每张专辑配套发行的混音合集"things we've remixed"的第三支单曲，文章详细梳理了乐队的发行历史与合作伙伴网络，包括Aspra、Cicero等多国艺人的参与。SoftWave自述受Erasure影响，定位为英式合成器流行与舞曲流行的混合体。整体内容为标准的唱片发行公告，缺乏对音乐本身的深度评论或艺术分析，且风格偏向主流合成器流行，与用户偏好的实验前卫路线距离较远。

items.body: Belgian gothic rock band Star Industry will release their 2007 album “Last Crusades” on vinyl for the first time on November 30, 2026, through Alfa Matrix. The LP is limited to 500 copies worldwide, priced at €18.99. ‘Last Crusades’ vinyl: format and tracklist The vinyl edition carries new artwork adapted for the LP format and reproduces the original ten-track album across two sides: A-side: “Lost Generation” “Pray” “Forever” “Out Of My Head” “Sin” B-side: “Last Crusades” “The Return Of David Gun” “Substitudes” “The Spirits Within” “Fall From Grace” “Last Crusades” was Star Industry’s third full-length album, originally released on April 20, 2007, and marked the band’s first release through Alfa Matrix. A digital version remains available on Bandcamp. Last crusades (Bonus Tracks Version) by STAR INDUSTRY Part of the Alfa Matrix Essentials vinyl series The “Last Crusades” LP is part of Alfa Matrix Essentials, a vinyl reissue series tied to the label’s 25th anniversary that brings catalogue albums to the format for the first time. Star Industry previously received the same treatment in 2020, when their 1997 debut album, “Iron Dust Crush,” was issued on vinyl for the first time. The band is currently working on a new studio album, scheduled for March 2027. About Star Industry Star Industry formed in 1996 in Maasmechelen, Belgium, when Arts Academy friends Peter Beckers, Stijn Kuijpers and Xavier Vranken united around a shared interest in early New Wave music. Marc Haerden (drums) and Peter Gerits (synths) joined shortly after, and the band recorded its debut material at Galaxy Studio. Star Industry played its first concert on April 12, 1998, at the Black Easter Festival in Ghent. The band’s debut album, “Iron Dust Crush,” was released independently in 1997 and later picked up by Purple Moon Records; its single “Nineties” topped Israel’s alternative chart the following year. A “New Millennium E.P.” followed in 1999 on the EuroRock Festival label, the same year drummer Kurt Lantin replaced Marc Haerden. The band’s second full-length album, “Velvet,” arrived in 2001. “Last Crusades,” released in 2007, marked Star Industry’s move to Alfa Matrix, followed by the live album “Black Angel White Devil,” recorded in Madrid in 2008. The band toured China in 2011, playing Hong Kong, Shanghai and Beijing, and made its United States debut at New York’s Tammany Hall in 2012. Synth player Rich Vanderhoven replaced Peter Gerits in 2015, the same year the band released the “Eilyne E.P.” and the album “The Renegade,” recorded at Motor Music Studio. Star Industry contributed a cover of “Stripped” to Alfa Matrix’s 2019 Depeche Mode tribute compilation. Co-founder and bassist Stijn Kuijpers died in 2021. Rich Vanderhoven moved from synths to bass, and Joël Vranken joined the band on synths. Star Industry’s current lineup is Peter Beckers (vocals, guitar), Xavier Vranken (lead guitar), Kurt Lantin (drums), Rich Vanderhoven (bass) and Joël Vranken (synths). The band has said its focus since Kuijpers’ death has been on completing a new studio album, due in March 2027.
items._cn_summary: 本文为比利时哥特摇滚乐队Star Industry 2007年专辑《Last Crusades》黑胶再版发行的资讯稿。文章主要内容为唱片格式、曲目列表、限量发行数量（全球500张）以及厂牌Alfa Matrix成立25周年纪念黑胶计划的信息。乐队历史部分介绍了1996年成立经过、成员变动、巡演经历以及多张专辑的发行脉络，包括在以色列单曲登顶、中国巡演及美国首演等事实记录。整体内容偏向新闻通稿性质，缺乏对音乐本身的艺术分析、声音设计讨论或风格评价，仅提供了唱片再版的实用信息，适合收藏者参考而非音乐赏析。

items.body: Italian EBM and industrial duo Alien Vampires will release their 2010 album “Harshlizer” on vinyl for the first time on November 30, 2026, through Alfa Matrix. The LP is limited to 300 copies worldwide, priced at €18.99, with no repress planned. ‘Harshlizer’ vinyl: format and tracklist The vinyl edition carries new artwork designed specifically for the LP format and reproduces the original ten-track album across two sides: A-side: “No Way Back” “Evil Bloody Music” “She’s On Drugs (more than me)” “See You In Hell (feat. Suicide Commando)” “Harshlizer” B-side: “Lies” “Control The Universe” “Nothing To Lose” “Far Away” “Her Blood Into My Veins” “Harshlizer” marked the start of Alien Vampires’ relationship with Alfa Matrix when it was first released in 2010, and includes “See You In Hell,” the duo’s collaboration with Suicide Commando. A digital version of the album, expanded with the “Industrializer” bonus disc of additional tracks and remixes released in 2024, remains available on Bandcamp. Harshlizer + Industrializer (Bonus Version) by Alien Vampires Part of the Alfa Matrix Essentials vinyl series The “Harshlizer” LP is part of Alfa Matrix Essentials, a vinyl reissue series tied to the label’s 25th anniversary that brings catalogue albums to the format for the first time. Alien Vampires previously released the limited-edition LP “Kinky To Hell” on solid red vinyl through Alfa Matrix in 2022. About Alien Vampires Alien Vampires is an Italian industrial, EBM and dark electro duo formed in 2003 by Nysrok Infernalien, who handles guitars and keyboards, alongside Nightstalker on keyboards and drums. The project released its debut single, “I’m Dead Fuck You,” in 2004, followed by the album “Evil Generation” in 2005 through Kold Finger. After the 2007 EP “Nuns Are Pregnant” and the album “No One Here Gets Out Alive” through BLC Productions, Alien Vampires released “Fuck Off and Die!” in 2009. “Harshlizer” arrived in 2010 as the duo’s first release through Alfa Matrix, a relationship that has continued since. Alfa Matrix issued a deluxe two-CD version of “Harshlizer” paired with the bonus disc “Industrializer” in February 2024, gathering additional tracks and remixes from the same period as the original album. Alien Vampires continued with the EPs “Clubbers Die Younger” (2012), “Hard Drugs & BDSM” (2014), “World in Denial” and “Destrudo” (both 2020), and the albums “Drag You to Hell” (2015), “Evil Degeneration Offspring” (2017) and “Fuck The Revolution Bring On The Apocalypse” (2018). “Drag You to Hell” featured collaborations with members of Ministry, Mayhem and Psyclon Nine. The duo’s most recent album, “Return Me To Hell,” followed in 2023 with a cover of Skinny Puppy’s “Assimilate” featuring former Slipknot drummer Joey Jordison, in one of his final recordings before his death.

items.body: Eleven singles into a twelve-single year, j:dead turns the lens on himself. The UK industrial project of Jay Taylor will release “Cannibal” on 2 October 2026 via Infacted Recordings, distributed through Believe Music, the eleventh entry in the monthly single campaign Taylor launched with “Pressure” in December 2025 and the follow-up to “Null” of 4 September. Infacted Recordings describes “Cannibal” as an industrial-techno-pop track that pairs harsh, stabbing saw synths with distorted guitars and driving electronic production, with Taylor’s vocals moving from soft, heartfelt passages to raw, screaming outbursts. Lyrically, the song uses cannibalism as a metaphor for consuming the parts of yourself recognised as damaging or as failures, and asks whether destroying and rebuilding those parts of one’s identity creates a stronger version of who you were, or something else entirely. Taylor wrote, performed and recorded “Cannibal” himself and shares the guitar parts with Hilger Tintel, the same arrangement used on “Null”. Motel-Music produced the track, Studio-600 handled mastering and Dokodemo created the artwork, again matching the team behind the previous single. Where ‘Cannibal’ sits in the j:dead single series The campaign started with “Pressure” on 5 December 2025 and has delivered one single a month since: “Disgusting”, “Who Knows”, “Feeling Alone”, “Silence Calls”, “Over The Years”, “Keep Walking” as the seventh single on 5 June, “Draws My Blood” as the eighth on 3 July, “Halo” as the ninth on 7 August and “Null” as the tenth on 4 September. “Cannibal” is number eleven, leaving one more single to close the twelve-month cycle. About j:dead j:dead is the solo project of Jay Taylor, based in Bicester, England. Before starting the project in late 2019, Taylor drummed live for Tactical Sekt, Tyske Ludder and Harmjoy. The first j:dead singles, “Haunt” in 2019 and “Feeding On Me” in 2020, led to the debut album “A Complicated Genocide”, issued by Infacted Recordings in January 2021 on CD and digital. The single “Tearing Me Apart”, featuring Teknovore, and “I’ll Wait” followed the same year. 2022 brought a cover of “DAS OM3N”, the four-track EP “Vision of Time” on Infacted Recordings, the single “Hold Tight” and two collaborations, “High Time (Chinese Takeaway)” with FabrikC and “Thrive” with Nature Of Wires. Taylor released “Surrendering”, a cover of “You Spin Me Round (Like a Record)” with Menschdefekt, the single “Harbour” and the EP “ROOTS” in 2023, and “What We’ll Be” followed in 2024. Since December 2025, Taylor has kept to a monthly release schedule, with “Cannibal” marking the eleventh step in that campaign.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章实际上是一篇新闻稿，介绍英国工业电子项目j:dead的第十一张单曲《Cannibal》。Jay Taylor以月度单曲发布的形式推进年度计划，这首歌融合工业Techno-Pop元素，锯齿波合成器与失真吉他交织，人声从柔和段落过渡到嘶吼爆发。歌词以食人隐喻探讨自我否定与重建的辩证关系。制作团队包括Motel-Music、Studio-600和Dokodemo，延续了前作《Null》的合作框架。发行厂牌Infacted Recordings虽属德国独立工业厂牌，但文章本身缺乏对音乐质感、编排巧思或创新性的实质性评论，仅是发布信息和背景资料的罗列，信息量有限且非原创乐评。

items.body: 2026.09.28 【Stereo×WebマガジンONTOMO連携企画】ピーター・バラカンの新・音楽日記 52 ラジオのように！ 心に沁みる音楽、今聴くべき音楽を書き綴る。Stereo×WebマガジンONTOMO連携企画として、ピーター・バラカンさんの「自分の好きな音楽をみんなにも聴かせたい！」という情熱溢れる連載をアーカイブ掲載します。 ●アーティスト名、地名を含む諸々の表記は、筆者の原稿どおりにしています。 ●本記事は『Stereo』2026年9月号に掲載されたものです。 ピーター・バラカン ブロードキャスター ロン ドン大学卒業後来日、日本の音楽系出版社やYMOのマネッジメントを経て音楽系のキャスターとなる。以後テレビやFMで活躍中。また多くの書籍の執筆や、音楽イヘ... 詳しく見る 円安の中クラウドファンディングで実現できた 今年も音楽映画祭（Peter Barakanʼs Music Film Festival、略してPBMFF）を開催します。9月18日（金）から10月1日（木）まで、会場は有楽町の角川シネマです。もう6回目の開催です。 どういうわけかここ数年音楽関係の映画がどんどん制作されていますが、大物のミュージシャンを題材とした劇映画（今年でいえば「マイケル」）を除けば、ミニ・シアターで上映されるものがほとんどで、日本では配給されない作品も少なくないです。 毎年映画祭のために権利を新たに取った映画と、日本ですでに公開済みで改めて上映したい映画を約半々で紹介していますが、今回は初公開の作品がやや多くなっています。このところの円安のため、金銭的にかなりの冒険で、去年に続いてクラウドファンディングで皆さんの応援をお願いしていますが、新作を10本上映する予定です。 Peter Barakan’s Music Film Festival 2026 予告編 作品的価値があっても上映料が高いと、満席になっても赤字が出る場合があります。無理に上映しなくても、と言われそうですが、クラウドファンディングのおかげでこういう映画もなんとか上映可能になるわけです。今回そんな扱いの作品が2本あります。 各時期のマイルズの素顔に迫る映像 一つは、今年で生誕100年のマイルズ・デイヴィスのキャリアを紹介するドキュメンタリー「マイルス・デイヴィス クールの誕生」です。同じタイトルのアルバムに関するものと勘違いされそうですが、そうではありません。 2019年にアメリカのテレビ用に作られた2時間弱の作品で、マイルズ自身の言葉をカール・ランブリーという俳優の声でナレイションに使っています。エミー賞の音楽映画部門で受賞し、評価の高いこの映画は日本でかつて劇場公開されたものです。マイルズの幼少期から、ビバップが誕生したころのデビュー、60年代の黄金クインテット（ハービー・ハンコックとウェイン・ショーターのインタヴューもあります）、70年代のファンクへの取り組みなど、各時期の音楽、そしてマイルズ本人の人物像に迫った内容です。 「Birth Of The Cool」予告編 決して過去を振り返ることがなかったことでも有名だったマイルズは亡くなる直前の1991年に、クインシー・ジョーンズの説得で若いころにギル・エヴァンズの編曲と指揮でオーケストラと共演した音楽を再演するコンサートをモントルー・フェスティヴァルで行ないました。そのモントルー・フェスティヴァルに関する大変充実したドキュメンタリーもあります。「They All Came Out To Montreux」は2022年にテレビ用の3回シリーズとして制作され、劇場版は約1時間半です。 「They All Came Out To Montreux」予告編 1967年に始まったこのフェスティヴァルはスイスのレマン湖沿いにある小さなリゾートの町モントルーで生まれ育ったクロード・ノブズが一人の力で立ち上げた催し物で、最初からすべての出演者の録音と撮影が行なわれていて、その資料の膨大なライブラリーも紹介されますが、ライヴで登場するのは例のマイルズはもちろん、ニーナ・シモーン、アリーサ・フランクリン、マーヴィン・ゲイ、B.B.キング、レイ・チャールズ、デイヴィッド・ボウイ、プリンスなどです。そしてこのフェスをずっと指揮し続けたクロード・ノブズ自身（2013年に76歳で死去）の話もとても興味深く、60年近く継続するこのフェスが彼のヴィジョンによるものだと映画を見ると納得します。 モントルーの映画にも登場するエラ・フィッツジェラルドのドキュメンタリー「Just One Of Those Things」もあります。スウィングの時代にデビューした彼女はビバップ革命にいち早く対応してスキャットのヴォーカルをトレイドマークにしたほどでした。その物語は十分見応えがあります。 「Just One Of Those Things」予告編 「A Poem Is A Naked Person」は泥臭くリオン・ラセルに迫った 「A Poem Is A Naked Person」という変わったタイトルの映画は1970年代前半のリオン・ラセル（日本ではレオン・ラッセル）の活動を描いた作品です。監督のレス・ブランクは2年にわたってリオンが持っていたオクラホマ州の施設に泊まりながら作り上げたこの映画はさまざまな問題があって、ようやく監督が亡くなった後の2015年に小規模で公開されました。 10年前に他界したリオンのもっとも脂が乗っていた時期を描いた、レス・ブランクの独自の泥臭いタッチの個性的な映画です。 「A Poem Is A Naked Person」予告編 他には、ずっと狙っていた「Soul To Soul」という1971年のガーナで行なわれた伝説のコンサート映画（ウィルスン・ピケット、アイク＆ティーナ・ターナー、サンタナなど）、短期間で社会が激変する60年代前半のニューポート・フォーク・フェスティヴァルに出演した多くのアーティストが登場する「Newport & The Great Folk Dream」、エルヴィス・プレズリーで有名な「ハウンド・ドッグ」のオリジナルを歌った強烈なブルーズ・シンガー、ビッグ・ママ・ソーントンに関するドキュメンタリー「I Canʼt Be Anyone But Me」、ユニークな活動を続けるキューバのピアニスト、オマール・ソーサを描いた「Omar Sosa’s 88 Well-Tuned Drums」、ゴスペル・ミュージックの創設者と言えるトマス・A.ドーシーを中心としたドキュメンタリー「Say Amen, Somebody」（邦題「マザー」、1986年公開、久し振りの上映）、そして在米韓国人の女性監督ムン・ヘヨンが伝説のジャズ・ピアニスト、バド・パウエルに捧げる形のドキュメンタリー「Bud Lives!」もあります。 「Omar Sosa 88 Well-Tuned Drums」予告編 盛りだくさんの新作の他に、坂本龍一、チャック・ベリーなど、多岐にわたる近作のアンコール上映も色々あります。東京の開催が終われば地方でも少しでも多く上映したいと思っているので、ぜひ足を運んでください。 イベント情報 Peter Barakan's Music Film Festival 2026 日程：2026年9月18日（金）～10月1日（木） 会場：角川シネマ有楽町（東京） Peter Barakan’s Music Film Festival 2026 in Osaka 日程：11月13日（金）～11月20日（金） 会場：シネ・ヌーヴォ（大阪） Peter Barakan’s Music Film Festival 2026 in Nagoya 日程：11月20日（金）～11月26日（木） 会場：伏見ミリオン座（名古屋） 公式サイト

items._cn_summary: 本文为日本音乐评论家Peter Barakan介绍其第六届音乐电影节（PBMFF）的专栏文章，列举了即将上映的多部音乐纪录片，包括纪念Miles Davis诞生100周年的「Birth Of The Cool」、Montreux爵士音乐节纪录片、Leon Russell传记片、1971年加纳传奇演唱会「Soul To Soul」、Newport民谣音乐节、Big Mama Thornton蓝调纪录片、古巴钢琴家Omar Sosa的纪录片以及爵士钢琴家Bud Powell相关作品等。文章以介绍影片内容为主，涵盖爵士、灵魂乐、蓝调、民谣、世界音乐等多种类型，但并非针对具体专辑或作品的深度乐评，更接近活动预告与影片综述的混合体。文中提及的爵士与融合元素与用户口味有一定关联，但缺乏对声音设计、实验性或音乐本身的深入分析。

items.excerpt: ポーランドの巨匠イエジー・スコリモフスキ監督によるカンヌ国際映画祭審査員特別賞を受賞したカルト作が初のBD化。デボンの人里離れた邸宅で効果音や電子音楽の仕事に携わる夫妻のもとに謎の旅人が現れる。歓待する夫妻だが関係は徐々に瓦解。やがて彼は、シャーマンから伝授されたという、聴いた者を即死させる叫び〈テラーシャウト〉の秘密を告白する。本作の不条理な恐怖は、何かで見たノイズ音楽の先駆者〈ホワイトハウス〉のライヴで観衆が耳から血を流し死ぬ漫画的な描写を想起させる。劇中、象徴的に使われるフランシス・ベーコンの絵画も作中の狂気を際立たせており興味深い。

items._cn_summary: 本片为波兰导演耶日·斯科利莫夫斯基执导的Cult电影首度蓝光化，讲述音效师夫妇在偏远宅邸遭遇神秘旅人、得知能以叫声致人死命的秘密。影片中效果音与电子音乐构成核心叙事元素，先行于噪音音乐的听觉暴力呈现接近白屋乐队现场式的极端描绘。弗兰西斯·培根画作在片中的象征运用进一步强化了内在疯狂。整体定位偏向艺术电影中的声音实验，与用户关注的实验电子、暗潮领域有一定交集，但本文实为蓝光发行新闻介绍而非深度乐评，且正文过短，缺乏对音乐细节的深入评析。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — Arriving just 3 months after "It's My Passion", at the beginning of 2026, "Third Squadron" is the most striking of the 3 recent singles by SPACE KITCHEN. It is similar to its predecessor but is a bit more prog rock vs pop oriented, with a late 1970s vibe reminiscent of the usual AOR suspects but also one of my obscure favorites, ZOMBY WOOF. Its 4 minutes of masticating rhythm, lead and bass guitar, stirring vocals, and dramatic keys passes by too quickly because it's set up like it should be a much longer track. Usually it's the opposite problem so I can't, or at least shan't complain. I'm sure this is better than versions one and two.
items._cn_summary: SPACE KITCHEN 在 2026 年初推出单曲《Third Squadron》，是其近期第三支作品，被归类为交叉流派前卫摇滚。乐评指出这首单曲比前作更偏向前卫摇滚而非流行取向，整体带有 1970 年代末的气息，参考对象包括 AOR 常见乐队以及较为冷门的 ZOMBY WOOF。四分钟的篇幅中融入了强劲的节奏、主音吉他与贝斯、激动的人声以及戏剧化的键盘编排，听感虽充实却因结构铺陈更像长篇作品而显得转瞬即逝。评论者认为该版本优于此前两个版本，但对作品的整体深度未做进一步展开。作为一支在主流前卫摇滚脉络中创作的作品，该单曲在编曲与音色上呈现出复古取向，与实验性、电子化或即兴类音乐方向存在明显距离。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — While this Toronto duo has just released its first more or less full length album, it turns out to be a compilation of the "best" of what came before, and that includes the trio of singles presented in 2025 and 2026 as digital downloads, so I'm reviewing those rather than an album with just 3 new songs. "It's My Passion" is the first, and it draws from a nearby adjacent and ancient well of catchy keyboard driven pop prog with appealing if not outstanding vocals in that laid back yet paradoxically shouted style. It might not be complex by any stretch but it's jaunty and almost makes me want to fire it up again before it ends but that just might be because it's the only track here, or it might be because I can feel the passion.
items._genre: crossover prog / keyboard pop / pop prog
items._cn_summary: SPACE KITCHEN 是来自多伦多的二人组合，这张专辑实际是此前单曲的精选合集，包含三首新歌。音乐以键盘驱动的流行化前卫摇滚为主，旋律抓耳但结构并不复杂，演唱方式松弛中带有呼喊感。整体风格偏向轻快活泼的crossover prog路线，强调旋律的可听性而非技术深度。评论者感受到创作者的热情投入，但作品在复杂度上有所欠缺。作为Crossover Prog类型作品，与用户偏好的实验前卫、自由爵士、电子音乐及暗潮等风格距离较远，音乐手法偏向传统的前卫摇滚融合流行元素，缺乏显著的实验性或跨领域融合特质。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Fuchs is, above all, Hans-J�rgen and Ines, partners both on stage and off. The couple had already collaborated under the name "Ines" in the 2000s, releasing four captivating albums in which the young Ines Fuchs took the lead as keyboardist and composed nearly all of the tracks. With the launch of the Fuchs project about ten years ago, the roles reversed, bringing Hans and his guitars to the forefront with a more prominent role in the songwriting. But make no mistake: the role of his partner, Ines, remains essential. This is especially true on the album *Too Much Too Many*, their fourth to be released under the name Fuchs, where the balance between their respective contributions seems to be at its best.From the flamboyant "opening track" of the band's first album, *Ines* (Hunting The Fox ? 1994), to the irresistible "How I Wish That You Would"?sweetly sung by In�s Fuchs herself?which closed *Slipping Into The Unknown* eight years later, the flamboyant style of Genesis took center stage, as well as the neo-prog of IQ or Asgard (each album, incidentally, featuring members of that brilliant Italian band), but with a softer, more feminine touch provided by In�s's particularly sensual keyboards, her enchanting harmonies, and her warm, instantly recognizable solos?deeply inspired by those of Tony Banks.On Fuchs' albums, these musical influences seem to have been more fully assimilated and reimagined, to the point where *Too Much Too Many* opens with "Don't Get Me Wrong"?a stunning example of neo-prog, solid and well-grounded, enhanced by beautiful vocal harmonies. The influence of Genesis at its best is still evident throughout the album, particularly on "Once Again" and its sublime synth solo, but overall, *Too Much Too Many* presents a more personal and varied form of symphonic prog?without any jarring surprises, yet one that consistently provides a sense of well-being for the listener. The album alternates between deep, melancholic tracks, with pastel tones drifting on a gentle evening breeze ("Of Hopes And Dreams And Bitter Tears"), others with brighter colors that seem to gush from a warm spring ("Challenge of Lifelong Learning"), arrangements that are constantly in motion ("The Middle Years"), harmonies as beautiful as stars that seem to light up one by one in the sky ("My Life"), and supremely successful melodies, such as on the superbly epic progressive track "Here in My Void " (12:18)?the album's undisputed highlight, which evokes both the Camel of the nineties and the most melancholic RPWL, and in which every note, however varied in form and appeal, seems to surge powerfully in the same direction, straight toward the goal of auditory pleasure. In an era when sanitized pop sells by the millions and is viewed by the billions on YouTube, it's reassuring to know that music as profound, rich, and sincere as Fuchs's continues to exist?more alive than ever with *Too Much Too Many*, a work boldly crafted with passion and talent to better embrace under-explored facets of the soul.
items._cn_summary: Fuchs 是由 Hans-Jürgen 与 Ines 组成的二人组合，Ines 负责键盘与人声，Hans 主导吉他和创作。《Too Much Too Many》是他们以 Fuchs 之名发行的第四张专辑。评论追溯了乐队从九十年代 Ines 时期到 Fuchs 项目的演变，指出 Ines 键盘风格深受 Tony Banks 影响，整体受 Genesis、IQ、Asgard 等乐队熏陶。本作在延续其新前摇根基的同时呈现出更为个人化与多面的交响前摇面貌，曲目在忧郁与明亮之间交替，有长达十二分钟的史诗篇章。乐评评价较高，认为作品真诚而饱满，但在风格上仍属传统新前摇谱系，融合与实验元素有限。

items.body: Review by Hector Enrique — Following the iconic 2001 album "Blackwater Park", Opeth had planned to release a double album. However, encouraged by Jonas Renkse (Katatonia), the Swedish band led by Mikael ��kerfeldt decided to release two albums simultaneously, each with a distinct musical approach: "Damnation," more progressive and less aggressive -whose release was delayed once it was completed due to a commercial decision by the record label- and "Deliverance" (2002), which is likely one of the band's heaviest, darkest, and most murky albums.Low tunings, thick distortion, persistent riffs, Martin Lopez's dizzying and at times excessive double-bass drumming, and ��kerfeldt's hellish guttural displays give the album its monolithic and brutal character, in tracks like the frenetic "Wreath" with its corrosive death metal sounds, the eponymous and superb "Deliverance," with its galloping and versatile riffs, hypnotic and hazy acoustic interludes, and a devastating instrumental finale led by guitarist Peter Lindgren, or the gothic darkness of "Master's Apprentices," featuring Steven Wilson's distinctive touch as he accompanies �kerfeldt with his melancholic voice and guitars.An atmosphere of extreme hostility from which "Deliverance" momentarily departs with "A Fair Judgment," which delves into the intricacies of progressive metal and evokes Floydian and Crimsonian influences in its structure, thickening in its final third with Lindgren's forceful, Black Sabbath-esque riffs -probably the best track on the album- and with the stripped-down "For Absent Friends," a brief and refreshing electro-acoustic tribute to the Genesis song of the same name, which offers a breather before the album plunges back into its darker textures.The experimental "By the Pain I See in Others" takes Opeth's progressive death metal into more twisted and dissonant territory, guided by �kerfeldt's cavernous and unsettling vocals to an intimidating new level and featuring a disconcerting circus-like middle section that evokes the grotesque theater of German composer Kurt Weill. After its musical development fades away, the track leaves a prolonged silence, interrupted by backward-played vocals from fragments of "Master's Apprentices," bringing the great album "Deliverance" to a close with a suspended, spectral echo.4 stars
